say:1:1630438001:1.text: Clearly, I'm a news anchor. Just look at me!

say:4:1630438003:1.text: About Meowris... I take no stance! I don't do biased reporting!

say:4:1630438003:1.female: About Meowris... I take no stance! I don't do biased reporting!
